sections.heading: 1. Plan your rest
lines: ① Make 1–2 days a week light or off.
② Rest day: a walk, easy swim or mobility.
③ Aim for 7–9 hours of sleep, same bedtime.
④ Add an easier week every month or so.

caption:
Toto has trained every single day since New Year. Lately the legs feel heavy and the times have stopped improving.

Training is the stimulus, but most of the adaptation happens while you recover. Skip recovery for long enough and sessions feel harder, soreness lingers and small niggles start to stack up.

Rest doesn't have to mean the couch. A walk, an easy swim or gentle mobility all count. Protect your seven to nine hours of sleep. Most people do well with one or two lighter days a week, plus an easier week every month or so.

Our team at Hybrid Physio can help you balance training and recovery. Book online via the link in bio.
